evidence.text: Categories: Coffee Shop / Café Vetekatten Kungsgatan Susanna Blåvarg Vetekatten in central Stockholm is a coffee-and-pastry institution. A well-preserved, tradition-packed café where you can sample traditional Swedish pastries of superior quality. They have six branches throughout the city and their first has been open, almost every day, since opening its door at Kungsgatan 55 in 1928.
